title: Traveller Club Relief on Cancellation Penalties (Air Ticket Fare Brands)
content:
Relief is taken off the penalty withheld on a cancelled booking under Air Ticket Fare Brands on the standing a traveller holds in the **Wanderlane Traveller Club**. Two kinds of club record are read: the traveller's club card, which shows the tier held and whether the card is active, and the tier-qualifying spend standing on the club points ledger, counted across the house over the last twelve months. The qualifying spend threshold is 2000.00 US dollars.

| Club standing | Relief taken off the penalty withheld |
| --- | --- |
| an active club card of the Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador tiers, with tier-qualifying spend across the house over the last twelve months at or above 2000.00 US dollars | the senior-member relief, a share of 0.40, is taken off the penalty withheld |
| an active club card of the Blue, Silver or Gold tiers, with tier-qualifying spend across the house over the last twelve months at or above 2000.00 US dollars | the member relief, a share of 0.20, is taken off the penalty withheld |
| an active club card of any tier, with tier-qualifying spend across the house over the last twelve months below 2000.00 US dollars | the entry-member relief, a share of 0.05, is taken off the penalty withheld |
| no active card of any of those tiers | no relief is taken off the penalty withheld |

Both parts of each of the first two conditions must hold together: the tier of the active card and the spend counted. A traveller holding an active card of the Ambassador tier whose tier-qualifying spend over the last twelve months is below 2000.00 US dollars is answered by the third line, and the entry-member relief of 0.05 is taken off the penalty withheld, the card being of a tier and the spend below the threshold.

Either side of the threshold. Tier-qualifying spend of exactly 2000.00 US dollars over the last twelve months is at or above the threshold; on an active card of the Blue, Silver or Gold tiers that takes the member relief of 0.20 off the penalty withheld. Spend of 1999.99 US dollars over the same period is below the threshold, and on that same card takes the entry-member relief of 0.05 off the penalty withheld. On an active card of the Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador tiers, spend of exactly 2000.00 US dollars takes the senior-member relief of 0.40 off the penalty withheld.
